result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue: overlapping text in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar listing.

issues.description: In the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing, the subtitle text is overlapping. It appears '25-35 min' delivery time and 'Order'/delivery info are rendered on top of each other, producing garbled text like '25–3Order delivery'.
issues.suggestion: Fix the text layout so the delivery time, price, and category are properly spaced and not overlapping. Ensure each metadata element has correct positioning and width.
